text:
If you were hoping this clear morning would just carry through, enjoy it while it lasts, because that weak cold front is closer than it looks. Right now it's a pleasant 79 with a light south breeze, but expect the sky to load up through the afternoon as shower and storm chances build, roughly 3 to 5pm onward. NWS pegs the high near 83 with a 40 percent chance this afternoon, though the European model is notably wetter than the American one today, so I'd keep the rain gear handy rather than assume you dodge it. The better bet for a soaking is tonight, with likely storms between 8 and midnight and a low near 65.

On the water, a Lake Wind Advisory is up, with south winds building to 15 to 25 knots and waves to 2 feet this afternoon, easing overnight. If you're out there, plan to be off by mid-afternoon before the wind and storms both ramp up. Tuesday clears out nicely, mostly sunny and near 82, a good day to reset outdoor plans.
